description: This Java class 'UtilAccounting' provides utility methods for accounting operations within the OFBiz framework, including account retrieval, account class hierarchy traversal, payment type checks, invoice type checks, and exchange rate calculations.

classes.name: UtilAccounting
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for accounting operations such as account retrieval, classification, and invoice/payment type checks within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getProductOrgGlAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the GL account ID for a product or default account based on product ID, account type, and organization, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the default account ID for a given account type and organization.

methods.name: getDescendantGlAccountClassIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all descendant GL account class IDs for a given GL account class.

methods.name: isPaymentType
methods.description: Checks if a payment is of a specified payment type, considering the hierarchy of payment types.

methods.name: isTaxPayment
methods.description: Checks if a payment is of type TAX_PAYMENT.

methods.name: isDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if a payment is of type DISBURSEMENT.

methods.name: isReceipt
methods.description: Checks if a payment is of type RECEIPT.

methods.name: isAccountClassClass
methods.description: Determines if a GL account class is a descendant of a specified parent class.

methods.name: isAccountClass
methods.description: Checks if a GL account belongs to a specified account class.

methods.name: isDebitAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class DEBIT.

methods.name: isCreditAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class CREDIT.

methods.name: isAssetAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class ASSET.

methods.name: isLiabilityAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class LIABILITY.

methods.name: isEquityAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class EQUITY.

methods.name: isIncomeAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class INCOME.

methods.name: isRevenueAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class REVENUE.

methods.name: isExpenseAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is of class EXPENSE.

methods.name: isInvoiceType
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is of a specified invoice type, considering hierarchy.

methods.name: isPurchaseInvoice
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is of type PURCHASE_INVOICE.

methods.name: isSalesInvoice
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is of type SALES_INVOICE.

methods.name: isTemplate
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is of type TEMPLATE.

methods.name: getGlExchangeRateOfPurchaseInvoice
methods.description: Calculates the exchange rate for a purchase invoice based on related accounting entries.

methods.name: getGlExchangeRateOfOutgoingPayment
methods.description: Calculates the exchange rate for an outgoing payment based on related accounting entries.
